robots.body:
User-agent: Googlebot
Disallow: /

User-agent: *
# MediaWiki's Special: namespace is machine plumbing, not content. It cannot
# rank, and on this fleet it was consuming the majority of the crawl budget that
# should be reaching articles: on the SG server Baiduspider spent 1142 requests
# on Special:CentralAutoLogin against 347 real article fetches in a 12h window,
# with Special:RecentChanges, Special:Nearby, Special:NewPages and
# Special:BookSources behind it. CentralAutoLogin is also answered with a 204 in
# smart-mirrors.conf and stripped from the HTML, but robots.txt is what stops a
# crawler asking in the first place.
#
# Deliberately scoped to Special: alone. The Wikipedia: namespace is NOT listed:
# /wikipedia/zh-cn/Wikipedia:首页 is the mirror homepage, the page that actually
# holds a Baidu ranking for 维基百科, and it is the single most valuable URL here.
#
# Both the wildcard and the explicit variant prefixes are given: Baidu documents
# support for * in Disallow, but the literal prefixes cost nothing and mean the
# rule still bites if a crawler's wildcard handling disappoints.
Disallow: /wikipedia/*/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/wiki/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/zh-cn/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/zh-hans/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/zh-hant/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/zh-tw/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/zh-hk/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/zh-mo/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/zh-sg/Special:
Disallow: /wikipedia/zh-my/Special:

Does GreatFireVPN work in China?

Yes, GreatFireVPN is specifically designed to bypass censorship in countries with strict internet restrictions, including China. We've been fighting the Great Firewall since 2011, using multiple circumvention methods to ensure stable connections.

Does GreatFireVPN work in Russia and Iran?

Yes, GreatFireVPN works in Russia, Iran, Turkmenistan, Myanmar, and other countries with internet censorship. Our app automatically selects the optimal server and connection method to bypass restrictions. It is also used in Cuba.

Does GreatFireVPN work in India?

Yes. Internet blocking in India is applied at the ISP level, so which sites are blocked differs between providers such as Jio, Airtel and BSNL. GreatFireVPN routes around these DNS and IP-level blocks, and its multiple circumvention methods keep working during the regional shutdowns and throttling that are common in India. Our Singapore servers keep latency low from most Indian cities.

How do I pay from inside Iran?

Direct rial payments are blocked by sanctions, but there are three reliable ways — crypto (best), Google Play / App Store, or an international card. See our step-by-step guide: How to pay from inside Iran.

Is GreatFireVPN safe?

GreatFireVPN is developed by GreatFire.org, an anti-censorship organization founded in 2011. We don't log your activity and don't collect personal data. No registration required — you can use the VPN anonymously.

How is GreatFireVPN different from other VPNs?

Unlike commercial VPNs focused on streaming, we specialize in censorship circumvention. We use multiple fallback strategies and over 10 years of experience fighting internet restrictions worldwide.

Is there a free trial?

Yes, we offer 30 days of free access when you first install the app. If you install through a friend's referral link and activate the bonus, you get an extra 10 days. No registration or credit card required — just download and start using the free internet.

How does the referral program work?

Share your unique referral link with friends. When they download, install, and launch the app on a new device, you'll receive an extra 30 days of free access added to your account, and they get an extra 10 days added to their trial. There's no limit to the number of friends you can invite — so you can use GreatFireVPN for free indefinitely!

Which protocols does GreatFireVPN support?

GreatFireVPN supports multiple censorship circumvention protocols: Meek, Webtunnel, V2Ray-Websocket, V2Ray-HTTP, Hysteria2, XRay-XHTTP, DNSTT, and VK-TURN. The app automatically selects the best protocol based on your network conditions to ensure a reliable connection.

How many devices can I use simultaneously?

A single GreatFireVPN account supports up to 10 simultaneous devices. You can use the VPN on your phone, tablet, laptop, and more — all under one subscription, at the same time.

What happens during a whitelist-based internet shutdown?

GreatFireVPN is built for the harshest censorship scenarios, including "whitelist" mode, when the authorities allow access only to a limited list of approved sites. Thanks to multiple circumvention methods, the app keeps finding a working connection and opens up the whole internet for you. This applies to Russia.

Can I access banks and government services while the VPN is on?

Yes. GreatFireVPN has a local bypass: government sites, banks and other local services open directly, without the VPN, even while the VPN is on. This way you keep access to local services and to the free internet at the same time. The feature is available in Russia, China, Iran, Turkmenistan and Myanmar.

Why does the VPN keep disconnecting on my Android phone?

Many phones — especially Xiaomi, Redmi, Samsung and Huawei — silently close background apps to save battery. A VPN has to stay running. See the guide: Stop Android from killing the VPN.
